g.text: Illustrative S–N trends distinguish an endurance region from continued strength decline

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Synthetic curves illustrate shape, not test data or allowable stresses for a particular alloy. Logarithmic axes, constant-amplitude fully reversed loading,
and assigned room-condition trends. Some steels show an endurance region under specified conditions; not every steel or environment does. Aluminum fatigue
strength is commonly specified at a finite life. Scatter, mean stress, and environmental corrections are omitted.
